description.value: Wetherly Inn & Spa is a high-end bed and breakfast on Salt Spring Island offering rooms with soaker tubs, propane fireplaces, and garden balconies, plus a full-service spa and heated outdoor pool. A continental breakfast buffet is included with every room, and a morning wake-up tray is delivered to each guest. The property is a tranquil, upscale retreat well-suited to cyclists looking for a restorative stop on a Salt Spring Island tour.

address.value: 169 Armand Way, Salt Spring Island, B.C. V8K 2B6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is a real, operating luxury B&B on Salt Spring Island with clear 2026 booking windows. The amenities page provides the primary evidence for optional amenities (EV charger, free parking, continental breakfast included, Wi-Fi not explicitly listed). No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, or cycling-specific services anywhere on the site. A notable concern is that OSM places this in 'Duncan' but the website consistently lists 'Salt Spring Island, B.C. V8K 2B6' as the address.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Duncan' but the property is clearly located on Salt Spring Island, B.C. V8K 2B6 per the website — likely a geolocation or tagging error in OSM.
A Level 2 EV charger is listed on the amenities page ('Level 2 EV charger available for guest use at no charge') but this is for electric vehicles, not confirmed for e-bike charging.
OSM tags 'internet_access=wlan' but Wi-Fi is not explicitly listed on the website's amenities page and could not be confirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating accommodation with an active website and 2026 booking windows; useful to touring cyclists visiting Salt Spring Island.
enrichment_extras.notes: The cottage and spa are seasonal (April 1–October 31). Main house rooms have a limited online booking window in 2026 (June 19–August 20) with exceptions for groups of 6+. A continental breakfast buffet is included with all room bookings.
